action: Browse the initial catalog.
expected: All six room names, capacities, supplied images, and hourly prices match studio.json.

action: Set minimum capacity to 6.
expected: Daylight studio, Live loft, Maker workshop, and White room remain.

action: Select microphones and piano with other filters clear.
expected: Only Live loft remains; equipment uses AND matching.

action: Set maximum hourly price to CAD 65 with other filters clear.
expected: Sound booth, Edit suite, and Maker workshop remain, including the exact price boundary.

action: Combine minimum capacity 4, microphones, and maximum hourly price CAD 70.
expected: Only Sound booth remains.

action: Choose filters with no matches (capacity 30 if supported, otherwise piano plus maximum price CAD 65), then clear them.
expected: An understandable empty state appears; clearing filters restores all six rooms.

action: Open each room's details.
expected: Description, equipment, image, capacity, and price match the supplied data.

action: Inspect Daylight studio on October 12.
expected: Availability distinguishes the 10:00–11:00 and 13:00–14:00 seed reservations from free time.

action: Choose Daylight studio, October 12, 15:00, duration 90 minutes.
expected: Before confirmation, the end time is 16:30 and total is CAD 127.50.

action: Book Daylight studio on October 12 from 15:00 for 60 minutes.
expected: One confirmation and one visitor booking show the correct room, date, 15:00–16:00, and CAD 85.00.

action: Create the F10 booking, refresh twice, and inspect My bookings and availability.
expected: Exactly one visitor booking survives; its occupied time still blocks another reservation.

action: Create F10, cancel it, then refresh.
expected: The visitor booking stays canceled and 15:00–16:00 becomes bookable.

action: Inspect seed reservations and visitor cancellation controls.
expected: Seed reservations keep blocking their times and cannot be canceled by the visitor.

action: Attempt Daylight studio, October 12, 10:30 for 60 minutes.
expected: Overlap with the 10:00–11:00 seed is prevented or rejected; no visitor booking is created.

action: Attempt Daylight studio, October 12, 09:30 for 120 minutes.
expected: A booking containing the seed interval is prevented or rejected.

action: Book Maker workshop, October 12, 10:00 for 60 minutes.
expected: The booking succeeds even though Daylight studio is occupied at that time.

action: Book Daylight studio, October 13, 10:00 for 60 minutes.
expected: The booking succeeds; seed reservations on October 12 do not block it.

action: Independently try Maker workshop: 09:00 for 30 minutes, 20:30 for 30 minutes, 08:30 for 30 minutes, and 20:30 for 60 minutes.
expected: The two inside-hours bookings succeed. The two outside-hours bookings are prevented or rejected.

action: Try a 09:15 start and durations 0, 45, and 150 minutes on a free room.
expected: Invalid inputs are unavailable or rejected with understandable constraints; only half-hour starts and listed durations can be confirmed.

action: Attempt confirmation with missing required inputs and with October 11 or October 14.
expected: Missing and out-of-window values are prevented or rejected. Dates inside the window work regardless of today's date.

action: Create F10, return to the same room and date, then try 15:30 for 60 minutes.
expected: Availability updates and confirmation prevents the overlapping visitor booking.

action: Open My bookings in fresh storage, then complete one booking.
expected: The empty state gives a useful next step; the site explains that this is a demo saved in this browser.

action: Use Pacific/Honolulu with empty visitor storage. Book Sound booth on October 13 from 14:30 for 90 minutes, then refresh. Export storage. On the same origin and profile, change only the browser time zone to Pacific/Kiritimati and refresh again. Inspect the booking, price, selected date, and occupied interval; attempt an overlapping booking at 15:00 for 30 minutes. Record the effective time zone in each capture.
expected: The reservation remains October 13, 14:30–16:00, CAD 90.00 in both zones. Its occupied interval still blocks the overlapping booking. No date or time shifts occur. Restore the common browser time zone afterward.

action: With empty visitor storage, set the browser wall clock to October 14, 2026, at 12:00 UTC before loading the site. Record the effective clock. Book Maker workshop on October 12 at 09:00 for 30 minutes, then refresh.
expected: The booking succeeds and remains October 12, 09:00–09:30, CAD 32.50 even though the browser clock is past the booking window. Restore the common browser clock afterward.

action: Book Daylight studio, October 12, 09:30 for 30 minutes.
expected: Stage 1 allows a booking ending exactly when the 10:00 seed begins.

action: Book Daylight studio, October 12, 11:00 for 30 minutes.
expected: Stage 1 allows a booking starting exactly when the 11:00 seed ends.

action: After the follow-up, independently try Daylight studio, October 12, 09:30 for 30 minutes and 11:00 for 30 minutes.
expected: Both zero-gap bookings are blocked. Availability and confirmation agree.

action: Book Sound booth, October 12, 09:30 for 30 minutes.
expected: An exact 15-minute gap before the 10:15 seed is allowed; the total is CAD 30.00.

action: Book Sound booth, October 12, 11:30 for 30 minutes.
expected: An exact 15-minute gap after the 11:15 seed is allowed; the total is CAD 30.00.

action: Create Maker workshop, October 12, 15:00 for 30 minutes. Independently attempt 14:30 and 15:30 for 30 minutes; then try 16:00 for 30 minutes.
expected: Both zero-gap attempts are blocked against the visitor booking, before and after it. The 16:00 booking succeeds.

action: Before the follow-up, start with empty visitor storage. Create Daylight studio on October 12 at 11:00–11:30 and 11:30–12:00. Also create a 15:00–15:30 booking, cancel it, and refresh. Export this storage and capture the two active bookings and the canceled booking’s absence. Preserve this dedicated migration profile and the stage 1 source. After the follow-up, restore that exact export on the same origin, refresh, and inspect all three booking outcomes. Cancel one surviving booking and refresh again.
expected: The two active bookings retain their room, date, times, and prices; preserve their existing identifiers if the implementation stores any. No identifier field or storage schema is required. The previously canceled 15:00 booking stays absent and its time stays bookable. Seed records remain unchanged. Canceling a surviving booking persists after refresh. If stage 1 cannot create this fixture, record a stage 1 prerequisite failure with evidence; do not inject fabricated records or claim an observed migration failure.

action: Inspect the time picker explanation, then book Maker workshop, October 12, 20:30 for 30 minutes.
expected: The 15-minute gap is explained. The final booking succeeds, ends at 21:00, and costs CAD 32.50. Cleaning does not extend the priced duration or require time before closing.
